title: Vertical Market Scouting Brief with Actionable Probe Set
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Synthesize a targeted, repeatable scouting brief for three regulated verticals (finance, healthcare, legal) focused on: (1) competitive model availability and variability in latency/cost across regions; (2) model feature gaps that block regulated use (auditability, deterministic outputs, redaction controls); (3) prioritized probes (mini experiments) field teams can run to validate vendor claims. Deliverables: 1) 6-page brief with executive summary and topline signals; 2) 12 prioritized probe definitions (workload + dataset + pass/fail criteria); 3) templated intake form for Sales/SEs to request rapid vertical probes; 4) one dashboard spec to track probe results and drift signals.
acceptance_criteria: Brief covers model availability, latency, cost, and feature readiness for finance, healthcare, legal
12 probe definitions documented with datasets, metrics, and success thresholds
Intake form reviewed by Solutions Engineering and Legal for operational use
Dashboard spec links to existing observability metrics and can be implemented by Console team
research_findings: Preliminary scan: two open models show favorable latency in NA but fail bias/audit checks for finance PII use
Quantization gaps: several promising model variants lose structured output reliability after 4-bit conversion in internal tests
Edge availability: APAC regions show inconsistent model variant availability causing fallback risk for Dedicated customers
Enterprise needs: buyers consistently ask for model provenance + KMS integration as a gating criterion
decision_points: Scope of probes: limit to blackbox API comparisons (hosted) for speed vs. deeper on-prem variants — choose a hybrid approach
Metric priority: emphasize deterministic structured-output checks and PII-redaction recall over raw perplexity
Resource allocation: request one backend engineer (0.2 FTE) for probe harness and one data engineer (0.1 FTE) to curate datasets

2026-03-11 — Design (Carlos Mei): Provided initial dashboard wireframe feedback. Recommend adding token-cost-per-probe as first-class metric.

notes: Probe templates use synthetic PII-masked examples when possible to avoid sharing customer data
Suggest partnering with Solutions Engineering to run top-6 probes as part of existing customer POCs to capture real-world signals
If dashboard implementation is delayed, exportable CSV and Looker view should be provided as intermediate deliverable
